Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Ms. Nand Prabha Shukla,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.G.A. for the State respondents.

In pith and substance, the petitioners are seeking direction to the respondent no. 2 and 3 for making prompt, proper and fair investigation in Case Crime No. 45 of 2023 under Sections 323, 325, 307,
498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Naujhil, District Mathura and conclude the investigation within stipulated period.
Learned counsel for the petitioners has prayed for issuance of suitable direction for fair and impartial investigation.

opennyai_summary.decision:
In pith and substance, the petitioners are seeking direction to the respondent no. 2 and 3 for making prompt, proper and fair investigation in Case Crime No. 45 of 2023 under Sections 323, 325, 307,
498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Naujhil, District Mathura and conclude the investigation within stipulated period.
From perusal of the record, we find that the first information report in the present case was lodged on 20.2.2023 and the present petition was filed on 17.3.2023 even before expiry of one month and therefore, we are of the opinion that the petitioners shown undue haste in filing the present petition.
Present petition is accordingly dismissed at this stage.
However, the petitioners are at liberty to avail the remedy as may be available to them in accordance with law.
